memory_candidates: Lean 4 subst/rfl-pattern gotcha: rcases with `⟨rfl, rfl⟩` on a disjunct like `a = x ∧ b = y` inside a tactic proof can eliminate the OUTER binder (x, y) rather than the freshly-`intro`'d one (a, b), silently orphaning later bare references to the outer names ('unknown identifier' errors). Safer to keep the equalities as named hypotheses and `rw` with them instead of destructive subst when both sides of the equation are local free variables.
